style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

rankedOutcomes.success: Native rounded form language replaces the flat primitive impression: the yellow folded cap has intentional crown/brim volume and controlled edge thickness; face, nose/ears, moustache and hair form coherent soft masses; shirt/collar/teal insert, palms, trousers and shoes read as a designed whole. Useful design improvements are rewarded, including changed proportions within functional envelope. Front target features inspire outcomes; unseen views must be coherent rather than identical inventions.
rankedOutcomes.failures: A material-only recolor that leaves dominant weak primitive construction; melted/flattened facial features; rear or side heads/cap becoming unconsidered slabs; disconnected garment or limb parts.

rankedOutcomes.success: Keep medium tan skin, blue-black hair/moustache, yellow folded cap, green shirt/teal panel, navy trousers and dark shoes. Warm soft rendering differentiates these families; navy and hair preserve volume and separation at intended size.
rankedOutcomes.failures: Palette drift, lime/neon clipping, uniformly orange skin, near-black garment/hair holes, muddy merged greens/teal.

rankedOutcomes.success: Broad gentle highlights and soft form/contact shading describe volume without a preferred horizontal light direction, directional ground shadow or camera-dependent lighting edits. All cardinal facings feel part of the same warm softly lit cartoon family.
rankedOutcomes.failures: Hard bright edge tracing, narrow plastic glints over large areas, blown yellow/skin, black seam bands, one-facing dark dead spots or ground-shadow direction.

rankedOutcomes.success: Selective garment/cap construction detail and controlled eye/skin relief enrich the native model where legible. Materials feel soft and tactile. Fine target grain, halo and pixel artifacts carry no authority.
rankedOutcomes.failures: Noisy procedural speckle, busy seams/buttons, protruding detached trim, uniform rough blobs without construction, copied ImageGen edge glow.

rankedOutcomes.success: At logical192x320 and native384x640, Samir, the expression, cap/hair profile, hand gestures and main garment divisions remain clear. All 10main+2supplemental actions preserve recognizable movement, clean sitting/eating contacts and coherent view changes. Canonical2D food remains plausible in body occlusion without moving its screen support/scale.
rankedOutcomes.failures: Tiny features vanish or sparkle, hands merge into shirt/head, food clips through opaque body to force exposure, eating motions miss the visible meal/mouth, seating floats or clips, seated frame cropped by standing-only bounds.

rankedOutcomes.success: All required samples have clean alpha, stable surface normals, no accidental overlaps/seams, holes, z-fighting, exposed cut ends, stray geometry, flicker, texture swimming or hard material patches. Review light/gray/dark backgrounds and actual12fps playback, not contact sheets alone.
rankedOutcomes.failures: Any material defect in a required facing/state, missing temporal evidence, old-style body/food overlays still active or painted/warped final pixels.

qualityCriteria.reconciliation: Accept source-specific technical proposal with explicit per-clip envelope/XY/tolerances in constraints. Semantic alpha128 fullUV food maps supersede obsolete nominal paddedquad width text. Body modeling redesign allowed within actual functional envelope; no original mesh equality requirement. Require all576native frames/48real temporalclips/backgrounds/stool/eatingcontext.
